methods.name: lock.setAutolock
methods.summary: set autolock seconds. transport:"cloud" (default) is unverified on real hardware (ack only); transport:"ble" sends ItemCode 11 over BLE and is the reliable path

params.name: name
params.description: lock name in config (not needed when deviceUUID is given)

params.name: secretKey
params.description: 32-hex shared key when deviceUUID is given

params.name: transport
params.description: "cloud" (default; unverified on real hardware) or "ble" (reliable; needs deviceUUID/secretKey/model)

schema.description: { ack, cmd, seconds } (cloud) | { resultCode, resultName, seconds, transport } (ble)

methods.name: devices.add
methods.summary: add devices to the company (biz3ManageDevice/add; items = QR-derived key objects)

params.name: items
params.description: QR-derived device key objects to add (biz3ManageDevice/add items)

schema.description: manageDevice ack ('Limit Exceeded' propagates as rejected)

methods.name: devices.reorder
methods.summary: reorder company devices (biz3ManageDevice/reorderDevices; rank = -index is assigned)

params.name: items
params.description: device objects in the desired order (rank = -index is assigned)

params.name: pushToken
params.description: mobile push token (FCM etc.; carried in the biz3 notify frame)

methods.name: devices.notifyManage
methods.summary: switch push notification for one device (biz3ManageDevice/notifyManage)

params.name: pushToken
params.description: mobile push token (FCM etc.; carried in the biz3 notify frame)

methods.name: access.registerCards
methods.summary: [experimental] register read IC cards to the cloud DB (per-record updateCardName)

params.name: cards
params.description: card records to register: [{cardID, cardName, cardType, nameUUID?}, ...] (nameUUID = firmware-assigned, from BLE enroll)

methods.name: access.registerPasscodes
methods.summary: [experimental] register read passcodes to the cloud DB (postPasscodes; symmetric with access.registerCards)

params.name: passcodes
params.description: passcode records to register: [{cardID|passwordID, cardName|name, nameUUID?}, ...] (nameUUID = firmware-assigned, from BLE enroll)

params.name: lastKey
params.description: paging cursor: timestamp of the last record of the previous page (DeviceHistory.js:37-44)

params.name: lastEvaluatedKey
params.description: paging cursor: lastEvaluatedKey object returned by the previous device.battery page

params.name: timestamp
params.description: timestamp of the history record to hide (from device.history)

params.name: timestampSecond
params.description: ts (second) of the battery record to hide (from device.battery)

methods.name: device.delete
methods.summary: delete a device from the company

methods.name: config.syncLocks
methods.summary: [experimental] import locks from the device list into the daemon config (writes config.json)

params.name: prune
params.description: also remove config entries that no longer exist in the device list

methods.name: config.syncHub3s
methods.summary: [experimental] import Hub3s from the device list into the daemon config (writes config.json)

params.name: prune
params.description: also remove config entries that no longer exist in the device list

methods.name: config.syncRemotes
methods.summary: [experimental] import Hub3s + IR remotes from the device list into the daemon config (writes config.json)

methods.name: config.syncRemoteKeys
methods.summary: [experimental] fetch one remote's keys from the server and write them back to the daemon config

params.name: remote
params.description: remote name in config (default remote when omitted)

methods.name: webapi.invoke
methods.summary: call a biz3 WebAPI proxy function (apiKeyId from config when omitted)

params.name: apiKeyId
params.description: API key id (falls back to config apiKeyId)

methods.name: webapi.sendCmd
methods.summary: WebAPI proxy: send a lock command

methods.name: ir.listKeys
methods.summary: learned keys of a remote (config name, or direct hub3DeviceId+irDeviceUUID)

params.name: hub3DeviceId
params.description: direct target: Hub3 deviceUUID (config-independent; pass together with irDeviceUUID)

params.name: irDeviceUUID
params.description: direct target: IR remote UUID (config-independent; pass together with hub3DeviceId)

methods.name: ir.learn
methods.summary: learn one IR key into a configured remote

methods.name: ir.listRemotes
methods.summary: list registered IR remotes by type

methods.name: ir.addRemote
methods.summary: add an IR remote object on the server

methods.name: ir.deleteRemote
methods.summary: delete a configured IR remote on the server

methods.name: ir.matchRemote
methods.summary: match learned IR data against preset remotes

methods.name: ir.addRemoteToMatter
methods.summary: register an IR remote as a Matter on/off device on Hub3 (experimental, untested on real hardware)

params.name: cmdOn
params.description: ON command HEX emitted when Matter switches the device on

params.name: cmdOff
params.description: OFF command HEX emitted when Matter switches the device off

methods.name: ble.invoke
methods.summary: invoke a registered OS3 BLE operation through the daemon host Bluetooth adapter

methods.name: ble.updateFirmware
methods.summary: start BLE firmware update (WM2: OPEN_OTA_SERVER / Hub3: MOVE_TO / OS3 locks: no command sent, SDK no-op path)

methods.name: ble.reset
methods.summary: factory-reset an OS3 device over BLE (destructive: invalidates its keys)

methods.name: ble.position
methods.summary: configure lock/unlock angles over BLE (configureLockPosition; OS3 Sesame5/6-family locks)

methods.name: ble.wifi.scan
methods.summary: scan nearby Wi-Fi SSIDs via WM2/Hub3 BLE (kind auto-detected from model)

params.name: model
params.description: device model (required: decides WM2 [dedicated GATT] vs Hub3 command set)

params.name: companyId
params.description: WM2 connect verification companyId (default: API_GATEWAY_CLIENT_ID from app.properties)

params.name: collectMs
params.description: how long to collect SSID publishes in ms (default 8000; Hub3 finishes early on the SSID_LAST marker)

methods.name: ble.wifi.setSsid
methods.summary: set Wi-Fi SSID via WM2/Hub3 BLE (kind auto-detected from model)

params.name: model
params.description: device model (required: decides WM2 [dedicated GATT] vs Hub3 command set)

params.name: companyId
params.description: WM2 connect verification companyId (default: API_GATEWAY_CLIENT_ID from app.properties)

methods.name: ble.wifi.setPassword
methods.summary: set Wi-Fi password via WM2/Hub3 BLE (kind auto-detected from model)

params.name: model
params.description: device model (required: decides WM2 [dedicated GATT] vs Hub3 command set)

params.name: companyId
params.description: WM2 connect verification companyId (default: API_GATEWAY_CLIENT_ID from app.properties)

methods.name: ble.wifi.connect
methods.summary: connect WM2 to the configured Wi-Fi (CONNECT_WIFI; WM2 only)

params.name: model
params.description: device model (required: decides WM2 [dedicated GATT] vs Hub3 command set)

params.name: companyId
params.description: WM2 connect verification companyId (default: API_GATEWAY_CLIENT_ID from app.properties)

methods.name: ble.register
methods.summary: register a factory-reset OS3 BLE device through the daemon host Bluetooth adapter

methods.name: ble.os2.invoke
methods.summary: invoke a registered OS2 BLE operation through the daemon host Bluetooth adapter

methods.name: ble.os2.register
methods.summary: register a factory-reset OS2 BLE device through the daemon host Bluetooth adapter

methods.name: events.subscribe
methods.summary: subscribe to events (topics: lockState/deviceUpdate/deviceListChanged). event.<topic> notifications follow

x-events.name: event.deviceListChanged
x-events.description: device-list change push (key sharing / device add-remove; biz3 pubUserDeviceChange)

x-events.name: event.ready
x-events.description: connection-ready notification sent once on every persistent connection (stdio/socket/ws/SSE/gRPC Subscribe)
